{{Top|leg}}
'''Feedback sensors''' were woven into [[Kamperdine Clothing Specialists/Legends|Kamperdine Clothing Specialists]] [[Body glove/Legends|body gloves]]. They monitored the wearer's biology and fed the data to a [[micro-processor]] to regulate the body glove's systems to keep the wearer comfortable.
